correction_log.finding: Current documents describe runtime image consumption as NOT_RUN while a project-local raster is bound by actual current runtime paths.

correction_log.disposition: Correct documentation to implemented static binding without promoting approval, provenance, or visual-quality status.

correction_log.finding: Existing runtime raster lacks a matching current approval/provenance record.
correction_log.evidence: No matching reference found in ASSET_RIGHTS_AND_PROVENANCE_RECORD or current asset record search.
correction_log.disposition: Legacy v1 remains unverified and is still consumed by MAIN_MENU only; do not re-promote it beyond that historical scene binding.

correction_log.finding: Settings overlay exists as a stub but has no button connection or approved settings contract.
correction_log.evidence: MainMenu scene contains SettingsButton/SettingsOverlay; VSMainMenu only exposes set_settings_open.
correction_log.disposition: Leave unchanged; track as a nonblocking design/implementation gap.

correction_log.finding: A Blacksmith HiGodot MCP session was unavailable, and direct desktop automation did not reliably target the Godot editor.
correction_log.evidence: No Godot AI session was registered for Blacksmith; attempted UI input was detected in a non-target foreground surface and was stopped before any project mutation.
correction_log.disposition: Bind v2 only through the existing WORKSHOP script consumer; retain MAIN_MENU on legacy v1 until a verified HiGodot authoring session is available.
